evals.prompt: Give me test scenarios for the indexterm element
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive, category-structured QA test-scenario document grounded in real DITA spec facts for <indexterm> (matching the manually-validated reference document from this session), plus a related-known-issues section (DITA-OT GitHub + Jira).
assertions: Output cites real grounded facts from get_element_spec (e.g. mentions <index-see>/<index-see-also>, @start/@end, or actual parent/child elements) rather than generic filler
Output includes multiple distinct scenario categories (not just basic insert/save/publish)
Output includes a 'Related Known Issues' or equivalent section covering DITA-OT GitHub and/or Jira
Output includes at least one explicit 'validate against actual product behavior' style caveat for implementation-dependent claims
Output uses structured Scenario IDs (e.g. IDX-001 style) with test data / preconditions / steps / expected result

evals.prompt: What should I test for the conkeyref attribute, and are there any known DITA-OT bugs with it?
evals.expected_output: Attribute-grounded test scenarios plus an honest answer to the known-bugs question (real cited issues or an explicit 'none found').
assertions: Output resolves conkeyref via the attribute registry (get_attribute_spec / build_test_scenarios), not a hand-invented list
Output explicitly answers the 'known DITA-OT bugs' half of the question with either real cited issues (URL/issue number) or an honest 'none found' statement
Output explicitly answers the Jira half with either real cited issue keys or an honest 'none found' statement
Output does not fabricate a plausible-sounding but unverifiable bug report
Output covers attribute-specific test scenarios (valid/invalid/empty/combination) grounded in real supported_elements/combination_attributes, not just generic conref discussion

evals.prompt: Generate test scenarios and a sample dataset for @keyscope
evals.expected_output: The full scenario document plus an actual attempt at generating sample DITA files via bundle_builder_service/dataset_packager_service, since the user explicitly asked for a dataset.
assertions: Output includes the full scenario document grounded in real keyscope facts (element and/or attribute registry)
Output actually attempts Step 4 (dataset generation) since the user explicitly asked for a sample dataset, rather than skipping it
Any generated sample files are real, valid-looking DITA/ditamap/ditaval content relevant to keyscope, not placeholder text
Output is honest about any errors/limitations encountered while trying to invoke bundle_builder_service/dataset_packager_service, rather than silently claiming success
The scenario document itself is not skipped or shortchanged just because file generation was also requested
